title: Plugin Workbench
subtitle: Manage installed Plugin lifecycle and capabilities, and inspect authoring projects, Ready Candidates, and build state.

product.title: Plugins
product.subtitle: Create and manage NomiFun enhancements, then choose which Agents can use them.
product.requirementPlaceholder: Describe what you want NomiFun to do better…
product.noDescription: This Plugin does not have a description yet.
product.emptyBody: Choose another category or tell AI what capability NomiFun should gain.
product.autoSaved: Requirements and generated results are retained automatically
product.modelRequired: AI Plugin creation needs an available Chat model.
product.creatorEmptyBody: No Package, version, or language setup is required. Nomi handles design, code, and Build.

steps.understanding: Understanding the requirement and system integration

product.currentEnhancementsHint: The Plugin contributes capabilities; NomiFun or an Agent still owns the task.
product.waitingForCapabilitiesHint: Product-facing capabilities will appear here after generation.
product.systemCooperation: Position in the system task chain
product.readyBody: The candidate is built. Checking it does not change existing Agent settings.
product.enhancementsHint: These capabilities enter the platform catalog for Agents and other compatible surfaces.
product.agentLinkHint: Agents select capabilities rather than binding the whole Plugin.
product.noAgentUsage: No Agent is using these capabilities yet.
product.noAgentCapabilities: This Plugin does not contribute Agent-compatible capabilities.
product.aiGenerated: Nomi created the first version, wrote the managed source, and built a candidate automatically.
product.aiUpdated: Nomi updated the Plugin and rebuilt it from your latest request.
product.aiFailed: AI authoring did not finish. The existing Plugin version was not replaced; adjust the request and retry.
product.aiTemporaryFailure: Nomi could not finish generation right now. The existing Plugin was not replaced; try again shortly.
product.importBody: NomiFun identifies the format, computes the digest, and validates the contents automatically.
product.importInvalid: This Plugin package could not be recognized. Choose a Plugin folder containing manifest.json or a valid NomiFun Plugin ZIP.
product.importNoAutoRun: Will not run automatically after import
product.importNoCredentials: Credentials and runtime data are not imported
product.importDropTitle: Supports NomiFun shares, Plugin folders, and ZIP files

actions.configureUnavailable: An installed Current version is required before this Plugin can be configured.

states.desktopOnlyTitle: Plugin Workbench is available on Desktop only
states.desktopOnlyBody: This surface depends on the managed Runtime, filesystem, and local Plugin Host on this computer.
states.unavailableBody: The local Plugin service or required Runtime is not ready. Check the Desktop backend and retry.

messages.restored: Rolled back to the previous version
messages.uninstalled: Plugin uninstalled; runtime data was retained
messages.configured: Plugin configuration and credential bindings saved
messages.artifactImported: Runtime package imported as a Ready Candidate
messages.buildCompleted: Build completed with a Ready Candidate
messages.dependenciesUpdated: Dependencies resolved and the exact lock was updated
messages.autoApplyEnabled: Compatible auto Apply authorization is enabled

confirm.uninstallBody: The executable target is withdrawn, while the Mount, config, credential bindings, and runtime data remain available for an explicit restore.
confirm.deleteDataBody: This removes the Mount, config, KV, credential bindings, and dataDir. The linked authoring project is not deleted.
confirm.deleteProjectBody: This deletes only Project Source, the dependency lock, and the Ready Candidate. The installed Plugin, Mount, config, credential bindings, and runtime data remain.

library.title: Installed Plugins
library.emptyBody: A Plugin appears here after importing or applying a Ready Candidate.
library.selectBody: Choose a Plugin from the list to inspect capabilities, versions, and lifecycle actions.
library.retainedDataNotice: This Plugin is uninstalled and cannot execute. Config, KV, credential bindings, and dataDir remain retained; deleting runtime data is a separate irreversible action.

workshop.title: Authoring projects
workshop.emptyBody: Projects created or imported through the authoring flow appear here with Source, Candidate, and Operation state.
workshop.selectBody: Choose a project to inspect its source state, Ready Candidate, and build operation.
workshop.projectDescription: Project Source, dependency lock, Ready Candidate, and installed Mount are managed independently.
workshop.runtimeOnlyBuild: A runtime-only project has no editable Source and cannot be built locally.
workshop.buildUnavailable: The project needs a complete Source snapshot and dependency lock, with no running operation.
workshop.runtimeOnlyNotice: This is a runtime-only project. You can test and apply its Candidate, but the original JavaScript or TypeScript Source is not reconstructed.
workshop.noMatchesBody: Search by project name, description, or Project ID.
workshop.identityHint: Project identity and build generation use exact CAS.
workshop.readyCandidateHint: A Candidate can be applied only after compatibility and test constraints pass.
workshop.importedTestProvenance: Source Bundle Test provenance: {{outcome}} on {{runtime}}. This is informational and does not count as a matching local Test.
workshop.noCandidateBody: A candidate appears here after a Build or read-only Artifact Import completes.
workshop.operationHint: Build and Import are durable, observable operations.

sourceEdit.title: Edit Plugin Source
sourceEdit.body: Replace or delete one managed source file. The exact Source snapshot and dependency lock are checked before commit.
sourceEdit.hint: Dependency changes require a separate exact lock resolution and are rejected here.
sourceEdit.pathRequired: Enter a safe relative source path.
sourceEdit.contentRequired: Enter file content before replacing a file.
sourceEdit.projectUnavailable: This Project no longer has an editable Source snapshot.

dependencies.title: Update Plugin dependencies
dependencies.body: Review the complete direct npm dependency map. NomiFun resolves pure ESM packages, verifies registry integrity, and commits package.json with the Host-owned exact lock through a recoverable mutation.
dependencies.hint: Use npm SemVer requirements only. An empty object removes all direct dependencies. Lifecycle scripts, CommonJS, native addons, optional or peer dependencies, unsafe archives, and stale Project facts are rejected.
dependencies.invalidShape: Dependencies must be a JSON object whose values are SemVer strings.
dependencies.projectUnavailable: This Project no longer has an editable Source snapshot and exact dependency lock.

share.title: Export Plugin Share Bundle
share.body: Export one exact Ready Candidate or installed current target. The fixed Bundle is content-addressed and returns through the same Candidate/Test/Apply flow.
share.includeSource: Include exact Project Source and dependency lock
share.privacy: Credential bindings, Config, KV, dataDir, Files, test inputs/outputs, API responses, and logs are never included.
share.destinationInvalid: Choose a destination and enter a safe new folder name.
share.readyUnavailable: The exact Ready Candidate is no longer available.
share.currentUnavailable: The exact installed current target is no longer available.

configure.title: Config and credentials
configure.body: Edit the declared settings and Credential bindings for {{name}}.
configure.configHint: Fields come from the installed Plugin's exact config schema. Secret-bearing settings must be declared as Credential slots.
configure.credentialsHint: Bindings contain only owner-scoped Credential reference IDs.
configure.credentialUnbound: This optional slot will remain unbound.
configure.credentialActionAria: Choose the Credential binding action for {{name}}
configure.credentialListBoundary: Credential enumeration is intentionally unavailable. Obtain the reference ID from its owning Credential product entry, then keep, bind, or unbind that ID here.
configure.noConfigFields: This Plugin declares no editable configuration fields.
configure.noCredentialSlots: This Plugin declares no Credential slots.
configure.persistedValidationTitle: The saved configuration reports validation errors
configure.schemaUnsupported: This config schema is read-only in the current editor

schemaIssues.requiredPropertyMissing: {{path}} references a property that is not declared.
schemaIssues.dynamicProperties: {{path}} contains undeclared or dynamic properties that this editor cannot safely replace.
schemaIssues.fieldType: {{path}} is not a supported string, number, integer, boolean, or enum field.
schemaIssues.enumInvalid: {{path}} has an unsupported or inconsistent enum.
schemaIssues.constraintInvalid: {{path}} has an invalid or unsupported constraint.
schemaIssues.secretConfig: {{path}} declares or resembles a secret config field. Plugin config cannot store secrets; the author must declare a Credential slot instead.
schemaIssues.digestMismatch: The config state and config schema have different digests.
schemaIssues.noCurrentTarget: This Mount has no installed Current target.

fieldErrors.invalidType: The value has the wrong type.
fieldErrors.minimum: Enter a value greater than or equal to {{limit}}.
fieldErrors.maximum: Enter a value less than or equal to {{limit}}.
fieldErrors.enumValue: Choose one of the declared values.
fieldErrors.credentialRequired: This required slot needs a Credential binding.

create.title: Create Plugin Project
create.body: Create managed JavaScript or TypeScript Source. Package ID is the stable machine identity; the display name is used in product surfaces.

import.title: Import Plugin package
import.body: Choose a plugin-package-v1 directory/ZIP or a NomiFun Share Bundle. A Share Bundle imports as a new editable or runtime-only Project; every import creates only a Ready Candidate and never installs or enables it automatically.
import.sourcePlaceholder: Choose a local package or Share Bundle
import.digest: Approved Artifact or Share manifest digest
import.digestHint: This must exactly match the imported bytes; unknown content is never auto-approved.

test.title: Run Plugin check
test.body: NomiFun loads the Plugin in a temporary test flow and checks that it can work with the current system. The checked version is not saved or enabled.
test.inputDigestHint: The managed test flow holds the input content; this request submits only its exact SHA-256.
test.sideEffectWarning: Plugins are trusted local code; raw network, filesystem, and child-process side effects cannot be fully isolated.
test.acknowledgeRisk: I understand that this test can create local or external side effects
test.acknowledgementRequired: Acknowledge the test side-effect boundary first
test.digestInvalid: The test input digest must be a 64-character SHA-256

apply.title: Save and enable Plugin
apply.body: After saving, the Plugin capabilities enter NomiFun's catalog and can be added to an Agent.
apply.initialInstall: Save as a new Plugin and enable it
apply.existingMount: Update the existing Plugin and keep it enabled
apply.targetUnavailable: The linked Mount has no verifiable Current target.
apply.noCandidate: This project has no Ready Candidate.
apply.allowBreaking: I understand this update changes existing capabilities and may affect Agents or automations using them
apply.acknowledgeTestWarning: I understand the local check is incomplete and still want to save and enable this version
apply.applyBlocked: This version still has issues to resolve and cannot be saved yet.

autoApply.confirmBody: NomiFun may apply future locally built Candidates to this exact linked Plugin without asking again, but only after a matching local Test, a complete compatible contract check, the same dependency lock and Runtime, and an atomic idle-Host fence. Contract-compatible does not guarantee behavior, cost, network effects, or data compatibility. Only one previous version is retained for Restore.
autoApply.linkedMountUnavailable: The exact linked Plugin target is unavailable. Refresh the Project before changing auto Apply authorization.

blockers.authorization: Standing auto Apply authorization is not enabled.
blockers.linkedTarget: The linked Mount or Candidate base target changed.
blockers.sourceOrTest: The authored Source lineage or matching local Candidate Test is incomplete or stale.
blockers.contractOrDependency: A contract, config, credential, resource, Host/SDK, or dependency-lock fact changed.
blockers.runtimeOrPlatform: The committed Runtime or supported platform no longer matches.
blockers.validation: Static validation is incomplete or an exact fact is unknown.
blockers.runtimeUnavailable: No committed JavaScript Runtime is available.
blockers.linkedMountUnavailable: This Candidate is not linked to an installed current target.

detail.identityHint: The product surface exposes stable identities, versions, and revisions, not Host processes or generations.
detail.targetsHint: Current and Previous pin exact Artifact digests.
detail.noCapabilitiesBody: The current version declares no Capability for platform consumers.
